message.name: MOTHERSHIP_STATE
message.description: Mothership pose, velocity and reference pose for the NUC-side RL controller. Added 2026-11-22 for the RL path only; MOTHERSHIP_DATA (52502) is unchanged and keeps serving the existing allocation path.
message.field: NED north position of the mothership CG
NED east position of the mothership CG
Heading, NED, clockwise from north positive
Yaw rate, clockwise from above positive
Reference north position, same source as the existing LOS guidance
Reference east position, same source as the existing LOS guidance
Reference heading, same source as the existing LOS guidance
Scenario selector mirrored from the mothership model
1 = manual RC override active. The NUC must ignore the RL output and command zero force.

message.name: MOTHERSHIP_DATA
message.description: Mothership force command at the mothership CG (body frame).
message.field: Yaw moment, clockwise from above positive

message.name: TUG_COMMAND
message.description: Upper allocation result for both tugs. Tug 1 uses *_one, tug 2 uses *_two.
